critical_code_review_comments: InlineTextTools.jsx L71 fix `if (!e.target.closest('button')) e.stopPropagation()` correctly lets tab-button click bubble; note this also causes the label to enter edit mode simultaneously (contentEditable focus), which triggers a spurious 'Saved' toast on tab click because onBlur commits when navigating away — non-blocking but polish opportunity: skip commit if the label was never edited (compare against undo stack length > 1).

ChatWidget.jsx onKeyDown Enter only calls send() when input has text; with an attachment-only state the user must click chat-send-btn (Enter on empty input is a no-op). Consider: `onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && (input.trim() || attachment) && send()}`.
ChatWidget uploads use fetch with content-type multipart auto — good; but the client-side 10MB check uses `f.size > 10*1024*1024` (correct) while backend probably uses same limit — aligned.

Landing.jsx line 312 saves chat_text_color on every native color input event; Chrome fires 'input' continuously while dragging the picker, resulting in many PUTs. Debounce (300ms) before calling saveText.
